meta.source: In-engine dump of the vanilla Everon world (Worlds/CoreOnEveron: a SubScene of worlds/Eden/Eden.ent) on a dedicated server, Arma Reforger build 26266485. Every entity with a prefab under Prefabs/Structures, de-duplicated across the 400 m query tiles. Footprint, floors and cellar from `tools\cli measure --surfaces` (collider bounds and horizontal surfaces).
meta.coordinateSystem: Enfusion world metres: x east, z north, y up; Everon spans about x -107..12348, z -100..12654.

fields.footprintM: [x,z] extent of the model bounds (local axes)
fields.heightM: top of the model bounds above the entity origin
fields.basementM: depth of the model below the origin when more than 2 m (cellar)
fields.floors: count of walkable floor levels (large horizontal collider surfaces) above y -1; null when the prefab was not measured
fields.doorChildren: door entities spawned under the building (per instance)
fields.enterable: door entities present and at least one walkable floor level: the building has a real interior (a heuristic, not a play test)
fields.furnishedSample: in the four town dumps, how many Furniture/Decorations props sit inside the building's footprint
fields.towns: nearest named place and instance count (rural = outside every place radius)
